## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

- **OKLO**: High-risk ticker with extreme vol (HV 125.7%) but stock at $19.47 with poor liquidity (OI <100 on most strikes); size constraints severe
- **TEM**: High-risk ticker with HV 98% but only $54 stock price limits absolute credit; better risk/reward in NVDA/AMD at similar vol
- **SHOP**: HV rank 67 decent but IV 60-75% range creates inconsistent pricing; prefer cleaner setups in mega-caps
